customer_name: China Construction Bank Suzhou New District Branch
business_problem: The branch wanted a more immersive and scalable way to deliver party-building education, distribute authoritative teaching resources to基层 teams and overcome the limits of time, place and manual instruction in traditional training.
solution_summary: China Construction Bank's Suzhou New District Branch introduced a VR-based smart party-building environment co-developed with Baidu VR and the Central Party School's Xinzheng Industrial Development Company. The deployment combines a digital party-school platform, curated teaching materials and People's Daily media resources with immersive VR content that recreates major moments in party history. In the new digital service center, trainees use VR all-in-one devices to enter guided experiences such as the Long March route, the Road to National Strength and themed party-history halls, while large-screen projection synchronizes device views for facilitators. The platform also includes online courses delivered through audio, video and web formats, hierarchical permission management, learning records and reporting so the branch can organize study in batches and audit participation. Baidu positioned speech recognition and language-understanding technologies as follow-on enablers for AI Q&A, turning the center into a reusable knowledge-delivery and training infrastructure rather than a one-off exhibit.

solution_components.name: VR Smart Party-Building Solution
solution_components.role: Provides the overall immersive training experience for party-building education.

solution_components.name: Digital Party School Platform
solution_components.role: Delivers online courses, learning resources, permissions and study records.

solution_components.name: VR All-in-One Device
solution_components.role: Lets trainees enter recreated historical scenes and interactive virtual exhibitions.

solution_components.name: Language Understanding Technology
solution_components.role: Supports planned intelligent question-answering and conversational learning features.

data_flow: Authoritative party-school resources, VR scene content and branch training plans flow into the digital party-school platform, where they are presented through VR devices and synchronized display screens; completion records and statistics are then written back for batch management and follow-up learning.
business_outcome: The branch established a digital party-building service center that made learning more immersive and traceable, broadened access to authoritative content and created a platform for future AI-assisted Q&A and knowledge delivery.
metrics: The center became the first pilot site of the 'Hundreds of Cities, Thousands of Enterprises, Ten Thousand Branches' digital party-building demonstration program.
Trainees can roam a virtual exhibition hall covering more than 1,000 square meters.
architecture_clues: The system combines immersive VR content with audio, video and web-based online lessons
VR devices can be centrally controlled to start or pause together
Large-screen display mirrors any VR device for guided explanation
Permission-based management supports batch learning and traceable activity logs
evidence_quotes: The branch introduced a VR smart party-building solution co-developed with Baidu VR and authoritative teaching resources to build a 'Digital Party-Building Service Center' (original: 引入中央党校欣正实业发展总公司与百度 VR 共研的 VR 智慧党建解决方案……成功建成“数字党建服务中心”).

Party members can experience immersive, interactive and scenario-based VR party-building courses, including 'Retaking the Long March' and other halls (original: 党员们可以体验到沉浸式、互动式、情景式的 VR 党建课程……“重走长征路”、“强国之路”、“党史馆”等 VR 体验).

The platform supports graded permission management, batch organization and report display so learning is recorded and activities are traceable (original: 通过系统权限分级管理，支持精细化组织学员分批学习，对应完善数据统计与报表展示，做到了学习有记录、活动可追溯).
Baidu VR plans to add speech recognition and NLP technologies to deliver AI Q&A interaction for party-building (original: 未来百度 VR 会持续增加 VR 应用形式，还将基于语音识别、NLP 等人工智能技术实现党建 AI 问答).
